title: The Bone Flute
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The flutist Halden plays the dead — a bone flute that lets the departed speak one last time through his music. When a king hires him to play his murdered son, the flute speaks a name that should be impossible: the king\'s own. Halden must decide whether to play the truth and die, or play a lie and live as the kingdom\'s greatest liar.
